note: Reel 1 storyboard, written after the approved cut (v4b) as the example of the storyboard stage: one entry per spoken line. Checked against __dbg: the note, the door sensor LED and the coughed puff are too small to count as seen, and the police car is only heard.

lines.see: At the bank counter Kai hands over a note while the smiling teller drops cash bundles into his open bag.
Close on the calm teller lifting a stack of twenties off a small metal plate, then dropping it in the bag.
Close on the teller turning to wave him off, all smiles.
Kai strolls across the lobby toward the door, grinning, the bag swinging in his hand.
Out on the street a countdown clock ticks beside his bag, the bag glows red, then explodes in a cloud.
Close on Kai, shocked, a puff of smoke at his mouth.
Cutaway on the counter: the hollow stack lifts off a sleeping dye pack on its magnet plate, a hand picks it up.
Kai walks out of the door; radio rings fly from the door sensor to his bag and a timer by the door starts.
A thermometer shoots up to 400 degrees, red dye sprays over the bills and over Kai.
Kai stands in the street, bright red, among red worthless bills.
